title: Consumable Berries
description: Allows players to eat Cobblemon berries, with special effects!
body:
Normally, Cobblemon berries can only be consumed by pokémon, as players cannot eat it. However, this addon mod changes that, allowing players to eat them like food. They can also give players special effects, to the benefit or detriment of them.

This mod is still in its beta stages and very few berries have an effect at the moment.

### Customization
There's two main files you can change to customize CB's behavior. The main one is effects.json, which can be changed by datapacks (`data/consumableberries/cb_data/effects.json`), this file determines which effects a berry can or cannot have.

The second file, `config/cm_berries.json`, determines which berries can be eaten, and what their nutrition and saturation values are. It also has the `alwaysEdible` flag, which if toggled allows the player to eat that berry even if their hunger bar is full. If an entry is NOT present in it, the berry cannot be eaten at all, you can use this to disable specific berries.

### Notes
- Consumable Berries disables the party select GUI when right-clicking a berry to avoid a conflict. You can still "pick" a pokémon by right-clicking them in the world.
- Berries cannot be eaten in battle. They'll behave the same as if you didn't have this mod.
